ios.desc:
Have fun with your friends and family by playing this collection of excellent multiplayer games via iMessage!

GamePigeon features following games:
	~ 8-Ball
	~ Mini Golf
	~ Basketball
	~ Cup Pong
        ~ Archery
	~ Darts
	~ Tanks
	~ Sea Battle
	~ Anagrams
	~ Mancala
        ~ Knockout
        ~ Shuffleboard
        ~ Chess
        ~ Checkers
        ~ Four in a Row
	~ Gomoku
	~ Reversi
        ~ 20 Questions
        ~ Dots and Boxes
        ~ 9-Ball
        ~ Word Hunt
        ~ Word Bites
	~ Filler
	~ Crazy 8!

	
More games are coming soon!

quotes.text:
GamePigeon (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gamepigeon/id1124197642) does something similar.
Completely unaffiliated but it’s a solid little gaming app and useful for playing games with older family members.
quotes.story_title: Did you know you can put a whole game inside of a push notification
